Rosehold Wrinkles

The castle is an enemy stronghold: whenever the party Spends Time inside @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold}, roll d4, and on a 1 roll here. Each Wrinkle also raises the Cold by 1 (see @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook}).

Roll d6

Roll Wrinkle
1 Patrol. Four Thornsworn Guards and a sergeant round the corner. They have not seen the party yet: one round to hide, bluff or strike first.
2 Wisps. d4+1 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.bab3acfcc2084623]{Frostbind Wisps} drift through the wall toward whoever last spent a Heart Die.
3 The thorns move. Black briars creep across the nearest door. Cut through (Spend Time again), burn through (any fire), or find another way round.
4 A mirror wakes. The nearest reflective surface shows the Queen's face. She says one line to one hero (use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1e4073f222b2931e]{Rosehold Whispers}) and that hero tests WITS or is Befuddled.
5 Glass ravens. 2d4 Glass Ravens at a window. Any that escape raise the Cold a second time.
6 Deep frost. The temperature drops. Everyone tests RESOLVE or becomes Weary until they reach a warm room. Anyone carrying a lit torch or wearing Mama Bear's amulet has advantage.
